chunks.text: # Acme Corp — Brand Voice Guidelines ## Voice Personality We are the smart friend who knows marketing. Not the corporate suit. Not the hype-beast. Just someone who gets it and can explain it simply. ## Do - Use contractions (we're, don't, can't) - Write short sentences (under 20 words when possible) - Use active voice - Address the reader as "you" - Be specific with numbers and examples - Show, don't tell (use examples instead of adjectives) ## Don't - Use phrases like "synergy," "leverage," "pa

on't - Use phrases like "synergy," "leverage," "paradigm shift," "game-changer" - Write in passive voice - Use ALL CAPS for emphasis - Make claims like "best in class" or "industry leading" without proof - Write like a brochure ## Examples ### Before (corporate) > Our enterprise-grade solution leverages synergistic AI capabilities to > paradigm-shift your marketing workflows. ### After (Acme voice) > Our AI helps your marketing team write better copy, faster. No jargon required. ## Channel-Speci

copy, faster. No jargon required. ## Channel-Specific Tone - **Email**: Conversational, like writing to a colleague - **Ads**: Punchy, benefit-first, under character limits - **Landing pages**: Clear headline, proof, one call to action - **Social media**: Short, witty, emoji-okay (sparingly)
